scope_notes: Scanned every git-tracked text file except .beads/, .perf-runs/, data/papers/ and files over 3 MB.

Excluded as vendored third-party data rows (their per-row reference/bibcode columns are upstream catalogue content, not tree citations): data/classic-ids/cns5.tsv, data/msc/msc_orbits.tsv, data/simbad/simbad_wds_xids.tsv, data/gliese/gliese_v70a.tsv, data/local-group/lvdb-snapshot.csv (per-row *_ref bibcodes), data/iau-wgsn/NEC.csv, data/stellarium JSON, data/classic-ids/bsc5.tsv, data/wds/wds_*.txt + orb6_orbits.txt, data/gcvs/gcvs5.txt + crossid.txt, and >3 MB tables (simbad_values/simbad_sptype bibcode columns etc.). Their header comment blocks were inspected; hip_ccdm.tsv and zucker2020-tablea1.tsv headers ARE included.

Bare dataset nicknames (Gaia DR3, Tycho-2, CNS5, WDS, ORB6, MSC, GCVS, LVDB, HIP2) are not counted as occurrences; author names, author-year, DOI, arXiv, bibcode and VizieR catalogue IDs (IV/25, IV/27A, V/50, V/70A, I/239, I/259, I/311, I/345, I/350, I/352, I/355, I/360, J/A+A/670/A19, J/ApJS/235/6, ...) are.
Eponymous references with no year (Espenak & Meeus, Meeus, Morrison & Stephenson, Juric, McMillan, Prugniel-Simien, Dyudina, Reid et al., Sion et al.) are included with year_as_cited [].
